summary: Phase 4 Internal CRM E2E testing completed successfully. All backend APIs (pipeline, agents, reminders, lead CRUD, stage management, assignment, activities, conversion, broadcasts) passed 85/85 tests (100%). Frontend CRM page fully functional with KPI cards, Pipeline Kanban (6 stage columns), Lead Detail Drawer, Lead Form Dialog, Reminders tab, and Broadcast tab. Stage changes, note additions, lead creation, and broadcast creation all working correctly. UI in Bahasa Indonesia as required. WhatsApp broadcast send is correctly marked as SIMULATION.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/leads/pipeline returns summary KPIs (total, open, conversion, pipeline_value) and 6 stages array
Backend: GET /api/leads/agents returns 2 assignable agents
Backend: GET /api/leads/reminders returns 4 follow-up reminders with H-7/H-3/H-1/overdue buckets
Backend: POST /api/leads creates lead with auto-assignment (round-robin) when assigned_to is null
Backend: GET /api/leads/{id} returns lead detail with activities timeline
Backend: PATCH /api/leads/{id} updates lead value successfully
Backend: POST /api/leads/{id}/stage changes stage and validates INV-7 (rejects invalid stages)
Backend: POST /api/leads/{id}/stage accepts lost_reason for lost stage
Backend: POST /api/leads/{id}/assign assigns to specific agent or auto (round-robin)
Backend: POST /api/leads/{id}/activities adds note activity to timeline
Backend: POST /api/leads/{id}/convert converts lead to customer and marks lead converted
Backend: POST /api/leads/{id}/convert rejects duplicate conversion (400)
Backend: GET /api/broadcasts lists broadcasts
Backend: POST /api/broadcasts creates draft broadcast with segment filters
Backend: POST /api/broadcasts/{id}/send marks broadcast sent with recipients_count (SIMULATION)
Backend: POST /api/broadcasts/{id}/send rejects duplicate send (400)
Backend: POST /api/public/quotation auto-creates lead (source=website, stage=new) with auto-assignment
Frontend: /app/crm page loads with 4 KPI cards (Total Lead: 9, Lead Aktif: 6, Konversi: 66.7%, Nilai Pipeline: Rp 35.500.000)
Frontend: Pipeline/Reminder/Broadcast tabs render and are clickable
Frontend: Pipeline Kanban renders 6 columns (Baru/Dihubungi/Penawaran/Negosiasi/Menang/Hilang) with 8 lead cards
Frontend: Lead cards display customer name, destination, pax, value, assignee, and source badge
Frontend: Lead Detail Drawer opens on lead card click with all controls present
Frontend: Lead Detail Drawer - Stage select (Tahap) changes stage successfully (tested new → contacted)
Frontend: Lead Detail Drawer - Assign select (Ditugaskan) present with agents list
Frontend: Lead Detail Drawer - Value input (Nilai Rp) present and editable
Frontend: Lead Detail Drawer - Note input and submit button work (tested adding note)
Frontend: Lead Detail Drawer - Activity timeline renders with activities
Frontend: Lead Detail Drawer - Convert button present (Konversi ke Customer)
Frontend: Lead Form Dialog (Tambah Lead) opens and creates new lead successfully
Frontend: Lead Form Dialog has all fields (name, phone, email, source, destination, trip_date, pax, value, assigned_to, message)
Frontend: Reminder tab renders with 8 reminder items showing H-7/H-3/H-1/overdue buckets
Frontend: Reminder tab shows WhatsApp 'Ingatkan' links for reminders
Frontend: Broadcast tab renders with 6 broadcast items
Frontend: Broadcast tab shows broadcast status (draft/sent) and recipients count
Frontend: Create Broadcast Dialog (Broadcast Baru) opens and creates broadcast successfully
Frontend: Broadcast Dialog has title, message, segment_stage, segment_source fields
Frontend: All data-testid attributes present for automated testing
